title: Fair and Efficient Distributed EV Charging Coordination Using Threshold Cryptography and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributed coordination of electric vehicle (EV) charging with the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) keeps EV constraints private but assumes that every participant follows the algorithm. This assumption fails in practice, where a biased operator or a man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacker can send inconsistent signals to different EVs, and compromised EVs can deviate from their prescribed updates. We first prove that attacks by such arbitrarily malicious, i.e., Byzantine, participants do not prevent convergence and therefore remain undetected, and derive the most damaging attack in closed form. We then propose a framework that combines a threshold-signed broadcast with upload recomputation, which detects every deviation without false alarms at linear instead of quadratic communication cost. translated_title: 基于门限密码学与机器学习的公平高效分布式电动汽车充电协调
translated_abstract: 基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的电动汽车（EV）充电分布式协调能够保持各电动汽车约束的隐私性，但其假设所有参与者都遵循该算法。这一假设在实践中并不成立——有偏见的运营商或中间人（MITM）攻击者可以向不同的电动汽车发送不一致的信号，而被攻陷的电动汽车也可能偏离其规定的更新步骤。我们首先证明了此类任意恶意（即拜占庭）参与者的攻击并不会阻止算法收敛，因此难以被检测，并以闭式形式推导出了最具破坏性的攻击方式。随后，我们提出了一个将门限签名广播与上传重计算相结合的框架，该框架能够检测所有偏差且不产生误报，同时将通信成本从二次方降低至线性。为保持优化的持续运行，每辆受影响的电动汽车可通过经认证的、具备车队感知能力的机器学习价格预测进行本地恢复，并且……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种结合门限密码学与机器学习的框架，能在保持线性通信成本且无误报的前提下检测分布式电动汽车充电协调中的拜占庭攻击，并利用车队感知的机器学习价格预测帮助受攻击的电动汽车实现本地恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework combining threshold cryptography and machine learning that detects Byzantine attacks in distributed EV charging coordination without false alarms and at linear communication cost, while enabling affected EVs to recover locally through fleet-aware machine learning price forecasts.
